[b]Virginia condemns Argosian aggression | The Daily Bird[/b]
[i][Feb.25.2025]

The Gendarmite National Treasury of Virginia officially condemns Lavian, Westmoran, and Goleornachan preparations for war in the potential scenario of an all-out invasion of Virginia. This has been concluded due to the recent mobilization of the Lavian navy close to Virginian waters and the Westmoran proposal of the Argos collective which seeks to neutralize the Treasury.

Virginian Governer Gérard de Valmont had this to say at the Virginian Proclamation conference:
"[b]Dear Virginia, it is our duty - as children of the Gendarme to ensure that her interests are protected. We have fought valiantly in guaranteeing this, as we were able to successfully knockout Demste in their war of aggression in Capricorn. But a new challenge arises, a band of even stronger Gendarmi-phobic terror states seek to abduct us from our mother. They want Gendarme to burn, from Bulwark to Rempart, from Alicia to Capricorn, and from Mudhulaipur to Kawachol. [u]This cannot happen.[/u] And so I call upon you, sons and daughters of the Gendarme - to fight both vigilantly and fearless against this new threat. [u]Que Dieu soit avec le Gendarme![/u] [/b]

END OF SNIPPET
[/i]

[quote=new_westmore;58587477][b]Taking a Stand | The Argos Collective[/b]
[i]ERENE: 2000[/i]

[i]The Democratic Republic of New Westmore is reaching out to the [nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation] and [nation]Goleornacha[/nation] with the intent to form the Argos Collective, a regional defense alliance to maintain sovereignty and self-determination in the continent. The need for such an alliance has become more apparent with the arrival of foreign colonial elements in the region on the island of Henaiia, now called Virginia.

Westmore firmly believes that colonialism is a scourge upon Erene and a potentially direct threat to the integrity of our nations. We hope our neighbours share the same sentiment too.[/i][/quote]
